parts.note_add: Per the catalogue figure 4000A-1 (S-005 EC-103) this check valve sits at the upper end of the split-air pipe (N201-40-740A) that carries air-pump air to the catalytic converter, joined by the air hose 1480-40-728 and pre-air pipe 1480-40-750; it is not the check valve inside the air control valve. Mazda no longer lists N201-20-730; the later RX-7 check valve 1480-13-730 is a different part.
S-005 figure 4000A-1 draws it as the long split-air pipe running from the check valve (N201-20-730) back to the catalytic converter.

specs.item: Check valve test (air pipe to catalytic converter): engine speed at which no exhaust gas may leak back at the disconnected air pipe opening
specs.note: 1985 12A procedure: disconnect the air hose at the rear of the intake manifold, raise engine to 1,500 rpm with the throttle, hold a finger at the air pipe opening; any exhaust gas leakage means replace the check valve. The 1980 manual (S-045 1A:2) gives the same 1,500 rpm test for its check valve at the air control valve. No 1982 source found.
